Frequently Asked Questions

Yes. You can use the same Global Delight account credentials (email and password) to log into Boom 2 that you use for Boom 3D. Simply enter your existing login details when prompted inside the Boom 2 app.
If the audio driver (Boom Audio Component / Boom 2 Device) installation fails, try the following steps: (1) Restart your Mac and try installing again. (2) Make sure you are running macOS 10.14 or later. (3) Check System Preferences > Security & Privacy — macOS may have blocked the driver; click 'Allow' to permit the installation. (4) If the issue persists, download the standalone driver installer from the Global Delight website or contact support at boom2@globaldelight.com.
After purchase, you will receive an email with a download link and your registration/license key. Download the .dmg file, open it, and drag Boom 2 to your Applications folder. Launch Boom 2, go to Register, and enter your license key to activate it. You will also need to install the Boom Audio Component (driver) when prompted.
Boom 3D and Boom 2 are separate products. Typically, there is no automatic cross-product discount. However, Global Delight occasionally runs promotions. You can write to their support team to enquire about any available discount for existing Boom 3D customers.
If you have a previous one-time purchase license of Boom 2, you can continue using it. To access the latest features introduced under the new subscription model, you will need to subscribe to one of the available plans (6-month, 1-year, or Lifetime). Log in with your Global Delight account inside the app to see available options.
No. A Mac App Store license and a Global Delight website license are separate and not interchangeable. The App Store version is managed through Apple, while the website version uses Global Delight's own licensing system. You cannot use one to unlock the other.
If Boom 2 is unable to launch, try the following: (1) Ensure your Mac runs macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or later. (2) Check Activity Monitor and quit any existing Boom 2 or Boom2Daemon processes, then relaunch. (3) Go to System Preferences > Security & Privacy > Privacy > Microphone and ensure Boom 2 is permitted. (4) Re-install the app if the problem persists. If none of these help, contact boom2@globaldelight.com with your system details and crash log.
